name: everhour
label: Everhour
description: Time tracking software that integrates into project management tools to track billable hours, set budgets, and monitor spending.

token.label: API Key
token.description: You can find your API key by going to **Settings -> API** in Everhour.

create-task.label: Create Task
create-task.description: Creates a new task in a project.

projectId.label: Project ID
projectId.description: The ID of the project to create the task in.

start-timer.label: Start Timer
start-timer.description: Starts a timer for a specific task.

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: The ID of the task to start the timer for.

stop-timer.label: Stop Timer
stop-timer.description: Stops the currently running timer. Fails if no timer is currently active.
